subject: Continuity artifact request: RTO/RPO sampling & telemetry extract
messages:
From: Natalie Powell <natalie.powell@blueharbor.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor Security <security@blueharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Continuity artifacts: RTO/RPO samples + telemetry extract

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking our SIG intake call yesterday. As part of our review we need sampled evidence for your RTO/RPO assertions to map to our controls. Can you provide the following artifacts (sample exports, not the full infra dump):

- A recent restore run log showing end-to-end timing (preferably a customer-tenant-like restore): start/end timestamps and any manual steps.
- KV cache warm-up samples (first-token latency vs warmed cache) for two representative models.
- The current RTO/RPO matrix you use for hosted vs dedicated vs private (versioned).
- Minutes from the most recent tabletop or live-witness exercise.
- Retention policy for backup artifacts (where metadata is stored).

If possible we need redacted samples (no customer PII) and an explanation of how you sample telemetry (system that extracts and frequency). Target for our compliance team is next Friday, 29 Aug. Let me know if that is feasible and if you need a formal upload link.

Best,
Natalie Powell
Sr. Third-Party Risk Manager
BlueHarbor Financial

P.S. We may request a short 20–30 minute walkthrough after we review the artifacts.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Powell <natalie.powell@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Continuity artifacts: RTO/RPO samples + telemetry extract

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear list.

We can provide sampled artifacts and a short sampling write-up. I'll coordinate with Ops for the run logs and cache samples (cc’ing Kimberly) and with Security for redaction and attestation language (cc’ing Ben).

Plan:
- Kimberly will export a representative restore run log and KV samples, and attach the RTO/RPO matrix.
- Ben will confirm redaction approach and prepare a short attestation note for the artifacts.
- I will package and share on a Drive folder with a one-page index and proposed walkthrough times.

Target: we will aim to upload the artifacts by EOD Thu 28 Aug to give you a day to review before your 29 Aug internal target. If anything slips we’ll let you know by Tue 26 Aug.

Sooj

Soojin Lee
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Natalie Powell <natalie.powell@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Continuity artifacts: RTO/RPO samples + telemetry extract

Hi all — attaching the sample artifacts we pulled. Notes below each item.

Attachments (sample stubs included in package):
- restore_run_2025-06-18.log (sanitized): contains timing for a tenant-restore simulation performed in our pre-prod cluster. Redacted bucket names and tenant ids; timestamps preserved.
- kv_cache_warm_samples_2025-06.csv: 50 rows: first-token latency vs warmed-cache latency for two model families (gpt-like small, and 4k-seq medium). Columns: model, run_id, seq_len, cold_first_token_ms, warmed_avg_token_ms, timestamp.
- rpo_rto_matrix_v3.xlsx: matrix mapping deployment types -> recovery procedures, expected RTO/RPO (target & observed ranges), last test dates. Version v3 (updated 2025-05-30).
- tabletop_minutes_2024-11-12.pdf: minutes and attendee list from last tabletop (includes scenario, outcomes, action items).
- s3_retention_policy_2025-01-10.txt: internal retention policy excerpt referencing metadata retention and artifact lifecycle.

A few operational clarifications:
- The restore run is a scripted workflow that uses our infra automation (no manual secret handling). The log includes automated start/finish markers — manual steps are noted but rare.
- KV warm samples were captured during an internal warmup campaign tied to a model onboarding test; the CSV includes the sampling script id and a checksum.
- We sampled telemetry at hourly aggregation windows and then retained an anonymized subset for compliance requests.

If you need additional columns or a different sampling window please say which window (e.g., 2025-06-15 -> 2025-06-21) and we can re-run the extractor.

Kimberly Park
Director, Production Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Natalie Powell <natalie.powell@blueharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2025 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Continuity artifacts: RTO/RPO samples + telemetry extract

Thanks — reviewed the artifacts Kim attached. A couple of security notes for BlueHarbor:

- Redaction: we removed tenant IDs and replaced them with stable pseudonyms (e.g., tenant-0001) and scrubbed S3 ARNs. The timing and sequence of events are preserved.
- Attestation: we will provide a short signed attestation confirming the samples were taken from production-adjacent runs and that no customer-identifiable data is present in the zipped package. I'll attach the signed attestation PDF after legal signs off (ETA EOD Wed 27 Aug).
- Additional telemetry: if you require a time-series extract of token-level latency per-minute for the restore window, note that will require a privacy review and takes longer — we can quote time if requested.

If BlueHarbor needs anything redacted differently, let us know and we'll update.

Ben Carter
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Powell <natalie.powell@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Aug 2025 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final delivery: sampled continuity artifacts and index

Hi Natalie — attaching the package to the Drive link below and summarizing what we delivered per your ask. I’m happy to walk through these live if you’d like a 20–30 minute session next week.

Delivered artifacts (redacted samples):
- restore_run_2025-06-18.log — sanitized, includes start/finish markers and per-step timing.
- kv_cache_warm_samples_2025-06.csv — first-token vs warmed metrics for two model families.
- rpo_rto_matrix_v3.xlsx — version v3 with last test dates and observed ranges.
- tabletop_minutes_2024-11-12.pdf — minutes and actions.
- s3_retention_policy_2025-01-10.txt — retention excerpt for artifact metadata.

Summary notes:
- Sampling methodology: hourly aggregation windows; anonymization by pseudonymization + column redaction; sampling script id included in CSV.
- Observed RTO: matrix lists target RTOs and a 90th percentile observed window from the last three exercises.
- Limitations: we did not include raw token streams or any PII. Per Ben, token-level per-minute extracts require a privacy review and will add 3–5 business days.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-BH-ARTIFACTS
Compliance ticket: HBSP-78234

If you'd like a walkthrough, propose times next Tue/Wed (30–31 Aug) and we’ll book 30 minutes.

Thanks — Soojin
